articles.title: Arkios: An Open Bilingual English-Nepali Language Model Trained From Scratch, with a Devanagari-Aware Tokenizer
articles.abstract: We present Arkios, a 1.04B-parameter dense transformer pretrained from scratch on 150B tokens of bilingual English-Nepali text, using a custom single-file C/CUDA training stack and a Devanagari-aware byte-level BPE tokenizer built for this project. On ARC-Easy and ARC-Challenge, Arkios exceeds three comparably sized open models (Pythia-1.4B, TinyLlama-1.1B, OLMo-1B) despite an order of magnitude fewer training tokens, likely aided by a match between our educational-web-text pretraining data and ARC's grade-school-science format rather than a general capability advantage. We report full evaluation results under standard protocols, including a correction to an earlier partial-sample estimate, and findings specific to evaluating small models in a low-resource language: the standard multiple-choice-letter prompt format used by common evaluation harnesses places this model at chance on Nepali reading comprehension, and simultaneously at chance on English in the same format, which would lead a naive benchmark run to conclude the model has no Nepali ability when in fact it does. Concretely, both languages score at chance in the letter-choice format (0.240 Nepali, 0.236 English, against a chance baseline of 0.250), while scoring the answer text directly reveals genuine, English-favoring comprehension (0.306 Nepali, 0.387 English). We describe a manifest-conditioned tool-use contract introduced during instruction tuning, where tool calls are permitted only when a tool manifest is declared in context and suppressed otherwise, and report where that contract holds and where it does not. We release both the base and instruction-tuned model weights under Apache-2.0. The training code and a small privately-sourced portion of the Nepali pretraining corpus are not released; everything needed to reproduce the reported numbers from the released weights is included here.
articles.titleCn: Arkios：一个从头开始训练的开源英尼泊尔双语语言模型，具有达罗毗荼语系敏感的词法化器
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了Arkios，一个基于1500亿双语英语-尼泊尔语文本从头开始预训练的1.04亿参数密集型Transformer模型，使用了定制的单文件C/CUDA训练栈和为该项目构建的Devanagari感知字节级BPE分词器。在ARC-Easy和ARC-Challenge上，尽管训练词量少了一个数量级，Arkios超过了三个规模相当的公开模型（Pythia-1.4亿、TinyLlama-1.1亿、OLMo-1亿），这可能是由于我们的教育网页文本预训练数据与ARC的小学科学格式相匹配，而非一般能力优势。我们在标准协议下报告了完整评估结果，包括对早期部分样本估计的修正，以及针对低资源语言中小模型评估的特定发现：常用评估框架中使用的标准多项选择题字母格式，使该模型在尼泊尔语阅读理解上处于随机水平，同时在同一格式下英语也处于随机水平，这会导致一个天真的基准运行得出模型没有尼泊尔语能力的结论，而实际上它是有能力的。具体来说，在字母选择格式中，两种语言都处于随机水平（尼泊尔语0.240，英语0.236，相对于随机基线0.250），而直接评分答案文本则显示出真实的、偏向英语的理解能力（尼泊尔语0.306，英语0.387）。我们描述了在指令微调期间引入的显式条件工具使用合同，其中只有在上下文中声明工具显式时才允许工具调用，否则被抑制，并报告了该合同成立与不成立的条件。我们在Apache-2.0许可证下发布了基础模型和指令微调后的模型权重。训练代码和一小部分私有的尼泊尔语预训练语料库未公开；这里包含了从发布的权重中重现报告数字所需的所有内容。

articles.title: When Does a Classifier Help an LLM? Classifier-Guided Prompting and Hybrid Classifier-LLM Models for Credit-Default Prediction
articles.abstract: Credit-default prediction is an important task in financial decision making. Traditional methods use fitted classifiers such as logistic regression and random forests on tabular features. Large language models (LLMs) have recently been applied to this task through prompting. In this work we study how a fitted classifier and an LLM can be combined for credit-default prediction. We distinguish telling the LLM to imitate a classifier from using the classifier to build the prompt. We hypothesize that a fitted classifier can supply the ranking ability that an LLM prompt lacks. We experiment on the Default of Credit Card Clients dataset, and report recall, F1, and the area under the ROC and precision-recall curves, with bootstrap confidence intervals. We observe that a few-shot LLM has the highest recall (0.47) and F1 (0.50) of any single model but ranks worse than a random forest (AUC-ROC 0.72 against 0.79). Instructing the LLM to imitate a classifier gives no significant change. Pruning the prompt to the classifier's eight most important features raises recall by 0.071 and F1 by 0.032. Adding the classifier's predicted probability to the prompt raises the LLM's AUC-ROC from 0.72 to 0.78, matching the random forest, while keeping 0.118 higher recall than it. The reverse composition, and the use of several classifiers, do not help. We thus recommend a simple classifier-guided prompt for LLM-based credit prediction.
articles.titleCn: 分类器何时有助于大型语言模型？分类器引导提示和混合分类器-大型语言模型模型用于信用违约预测
articles.abstractCn: 信用违约预测是金融决策中的一个重要任务。传统方法使用逻辑回归和随机森林等拟合分类器对表格特征进行建模。近年来，大型语言模型（LLM）通过提示技术被应用于该任务。在本工作中，我们研究了如何将拟合分类器和LLM结合用于信用违约预测。我们区分了让LLM模仿分类器和使用分类器构建提示两种方法。我们假设拟合分类器可以为缺乏排序能力的LLM提示提供排序能力。我们在“信用卡客户违约”数据集上进行了实验，并报告了召回率、F1值以及ROC曲线和精确率-召回曲线下的面积，并提供了自举置信区间。我们观察到，少样本LLM具有最高的召回率（0.47）和F1值（0.50），但其在随机森林（AUC-ROC 0.72对比0.79）中的排名较差。让LLM模仿分类器没有带来显著变化。将提示修剪为分类器的八个最重要的特征将召回率提高了0.071，F1值提高了0.032。将分类器的预测概率添加到提示中，将LLM的AUC-ROC从0.72提高到0.78，与随机森林持平，同时保持了比随机森林高0.118的召回率。反向组合和使用多个分类器均无帮助。因此，我们推荐使用简单的分类器引导提示进行基于LLM的信用预测。

articles.title: Budget-Aware Compression Pipeline for Single-GPU LLM Inference: Methods, Trade-offs, and Coupling Effects
articles.abstract: Single-GPU deployment of 70B-parameter language models on an NVIDIA GPU is constrained by device memory, long-context throughput, and engineering integration cost. We cast single-GPU inference as a budget-aware design problem over these three axes and study how pruning, quantization, and KV-cache compression interact under realistic execution. Controlled ablations show that layer-wise pruning makes weight quantization more robust. KV-cache sparsification complements INT8 KV quantization by reducing memory without hurting decoding speed, while static vector quantizers often conflict with dynamic caching. Guided by these coupling results and explicit budget tracking, we assembled a practical pipeline and compressed a 70B model to about 33 GB, sustained about 57 tokens/s on 10k token prompts on a single A40, and kept absolute accuracy within 5% on common and reasoning benchmarks. We contribute design rules and a reproducible evaluation protocol that jointly report quality, memory, and end-to-end speed, and we provide a foundation for automated pipeline search under realistic single-GPU constraints.
articles.titleCn: 单GPU LLM推理的预算感知压缩流程：方法、权衡与耦合效应
articles.abstractCn: 在NVIDIA GPU上部署70B参数语言模型的单GPU方案受限于设备内存、长上下文吞吐量以及工程集成成本。我们将单GPU推理视为一个在上述三个维度上的预算感知设计问题，并研究了剪枝、量化和KV缓存压缩在真实执行环境下的相互作用。受控消融实验表明，逐层剪枝使权重量化更加鲁棒。KV缓存稀疏化通过减少内存而不影响解码速度来补充INT8 KV量化，而静态向量量化器往往与动态缓存冲突。基于这些耦合结果和明确的预算跟踪，我们组装了一个实用流程，将70B模型压缩至约33GB，在单A40 GPU上对10k token提示的持续吞吐量约为57 tokens/s，并在常见推理基准测试中保持了5%内的绝对准确率。我们贡献了设计规则和可复现的评估协议，该协议联合报告了质量、内存和端到端速度，并为在真实单GPU约束下的自动化流程搜索提供了基础。

articles.title: How do World Models and Policies Compose in LLM Agents? A Joint Spectral and Behavioral Account
articles.abstract: How do LLM agents come to both understand environments they act in and master tasks set within them? Through controlled experiments combining world-model training (next-state prediction) and policy training (reward maximization), we investigate this question. We dissect the resulting models through their additive parameter updates. Geometrically, we find effective world-model updates are low-rank and share an input-feature subspace with policy updates while writing to nearly orthogonal output directions, whether trained separately or sequentially. However, we find that, in projection interventions, the sequential update induces more robustness than separate policy RL when removing the world model's leading input directions, suggesting that it has learned alternative input pathways. Behaviorally, we find the sequentially trained agent explores a wider range of states and actions. Based on this, we ask: does policy training preserve world knowledge as well as it could? We probe this with training-free merging built on the geometrically motivated input basis plus an online world-model loss during policy RL, and show both improve over the untreated baseline. Our findings suggest world knowledge and task-directed ability can be learned in geometrically complementary forms, and that future post-training pipelines should consider how best to engineer the interface between them.
articles.titleCn: 世界模型和政策在大型语言模型智能体中的组合方式：一种联合频谱和行为解释
articles.abstractCn: LLM智能体是如何理解它们所处环境并掌握其中设定的任务的？通过结合世界模型训练（状态预测）和策略训练（奖励最大化）的受控实验，我们探究了这个问题。我们通过分析模型参数的增量更新来剖析所得模型。从几何角度来看，我们发现有效的世界模型更新是低秩的，并且与策略更新共享一个输入特征子空间，同时向几乎正交的输出方向写入，无论是单独训练还是顺序训练。然而，我们发现，在投影干预中，顺序更新在移除世界模型的领先输入方向时，比单独的策略强化学习表现出更强的鲁棒性，这表明它已经学会了替代的输入路径。从行为上看，我们发现顺序训练的智能体探索了更广泛的状态和动作范围。基于这一点，我们提出：策略训练是否像它应该的那样保留了世界知识？我们通过基于几何动机的输入基和策略强化学习期间在线世界模型损失的无训练合并来探究这个问题，并表明两者都优于未处理的基线。我们的研究结果表明，世界知识和任务导向能力可以以几何互补的形式学习，并且未来的后训练流程应考虑如何最好地设计它们之间的接口。

articles.title: Pak3H: Evaluating the Cost of Cultural Mismatch in LLM Alignment with a Human-Contextualized Urdu Benchmark
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong Helpfulness, Harmlessness, and Honesty (3H) alignment in English-centric settings, but these gains transfer poorly to low-resource languages due to cultural mismatches. Existing multilingual 3H benchmarks rely predominantly on automated translation or LLM based synthesis, propagating source-language biases while sacrificing local relevance. To address this gap, we introduce Pak3H1, the first human-validated, culturally contextualized Urdu benchmark suite for 3H alignment, comprising PakAlpaca (helpfulness), PakBeaverTails (harmlessness), and PakTruthfulQA (honesty). Our multi-stage pipeline integrates manual cultural adaptation and dictionary-guided post editing to prioritize native speaker judgment, ensuring both semantic fidelity and contextual authenticity. Zero-shot evaluations across multiple open and proprietary LLM architectures reveal systematic cross-lingual alignment gaps: helpfulness win rates decline under localized contexts, harmlessness guardrails break down against regional safety risks, and composite honesty metrics degrade substantially due to localized factual constraints. These findings expose structural limitations in current alignment approaches, underscoring the necessity of human-guided localization for equitable multilingual evaluation.
articles.comment: We introduce Pak3H, a human-validated Urdu benchmark for helpfulness, harmlessness, and honesty. Zero-shot evaluations show LLM performance degrades across all three dimensions in low-resourced contextualized settings
articles.titleCn: Pak3H：评估人类语境化乌尔都语基准在LLM对齐中的文化错配成本
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在以英语为中心的环境下表现出强大的助益性、无害性和诚实性（3H）一致性，但这些优势难以迁移到低资源语言中，主要原因是文化差异。现有的多语言3H基准主要依赖自动翻译或基于LLM的合成，这会传播源语言偏见，同时牺牲了地方相关性。为填补这一空白，我们引入了Pak3H1，这是首个经过人工验证、具有文化背景的乌尔都语3H一致性基准套件，包括PakAlpaca（助益性）、PakBeaverTails（无害性）和PakTruthfulQA（诚实性）。我们的多阶段流程整合了人工文化适应和词典引导的后编辑，优先考虑母语者的判断，确保了语义保真度和语境真实性。在多个公开和专有LLM架构上的零样本评估揭示了系统性的跨语言一致性差距：在本地化语境下，助益性胜率下降，无害性防护措施在区域安全风险面前失效，复合诚实性指标因本地化事实限制而大幅恶化。这些发现揭示了当前一致性方法的结构性局限，强调了为公平的多语言评估进行人工引导本地化的必要性。

articles.title: The Language of the Question Selects the Market: Query Language and Exit IP as Separable Factors in Commercial Recommendations from a Generative Search Interface
articles.abstract: When a generative search interface answers a commercial question, which market's products it names is decided before the model reasons about the products. We report a controlled probe of 234 runs against the logged-out ChatGPT web interface and the OpenAI API, collected on 29 and 30 August 2026 across four exit countries and six query languages, with six identical runs per cell. Three results. First, the top recommendation is unstable: it changed across six identical runs on four of six prompts, and that rate was identical in the browser interface and in the API with web search both enabled and disabled, so instability is a property of the system and not of the surface. Second, query language, and not location, decides whether local suppliers appear at all. Where the query language matched the country, a global brand won 1 of 24 runs; asked in English on the same connections, local brands took 0 of 6 runs in Estonia and Turkiye. Third, language and location are separable and act on different things: holding the query language fixed and moving only the exit IP moves the market whose brands are named while the answer stays in the query language. We show this on two unrelated pairs, Turkish asked from Berlin and Russian asked from Tallinn, and in both the answer names the resident country's suppliers. A minority language occupies a middle tier: Russian asked from Estonia names an Estonian supplier in 4 of 6 runs and a global one in all six, where Estonian names a local supplier in every run and English names none. A negative control in a second category, coded with the same instrument, shows no language effect at all, and disconfirms our own expectation: that category does have domestic suppliers and none was named in any language, which points the explanation at whether a category is nationally regulated rather than at whether it is nationally supplied.

articles.titleCn: 问题语言选择市场：查询语言和退出IP作为生成式搜索界面商业推荐中的可分离因素
articles.abstractCn: 当生成式搜索界面回答商业问题时，其命名的产品所属的市场是在模型推理产品之前确定的。我们报告了一项针对已登出ChatGPT网页界面和OpenAI API的234次运行的控制探测，数据于2026年8月29日和30日收集，覆盖四个退出国家和六种查询语言，每个单元格进行六次相同的运行。以下是三个结果。首先，顶级推荐不稳定：在六个提示中的四个上，它在六次相同的运行中发生了变化，无论是在启用网络搜索的浏览器界面还是在API中，这种不稳定性都是系统本身的属性，而非界面问题。其次，查询语言而非地理位置决定了本地供应商是否出现。当查询语言与国家匹配时，全球品牌在24次运行中仅赢得1次；在相同的连接上用英语提问，爱沙尼亚和土耳其中本地品牌分别占0次中的6次。第三，语言和地理位置是可分离的，它们作用于不同的事物：保持查询语言不变，仅移动退出IP会改变被命名品牌的市场，而答案仍保持查询语言。我们在两个不相关的对例中展示了这一点，从柏林提问的土耳其语和从塔林提问的俄语，在这两种情况下，答案都命名了居民国家的供应商。少数语言占据中间层级：从爱沙尼亚提问的俄语在6次运行中的4次命名了爱沙尼亚供应商，在所有6次中命名了全球供应商；爱沙尼亚在每次运行中都命名了本地供应商，英语则一次也没有命名。在第二类中的负控制实验，使用相同的工具编码，显示没有任何语言效应，并否定了我们的预期：该类别确实有本地供应商，但在任何语言中都没有被命名，这表明解释应指向该类别是否受到国家监管，而非是否由本国供应。

articles.title: Balance of Benchmarks: Semantic Density Reweighting for Benchmark Multiplicity and Task-Conditioned Evaluation
articles.abstract: Language models are commonly compared by averaging scores across a benchmark list with equal weight. Such lists grow through publication outside an explicit measurement design, so equal weighting turns the density of published benchmarks into an implicit capability weight: densely benchmarked regions count repeatedly. We introduce Balance of Benchmarks (BoB), which embeds benchmark descriptions and assigns each benchmark an inverse-density semantic weight. Nearby entries share aggregate influence at a disclosed density scale. After equating heterogeneous scores onto a common latent scale, a residual field uses the same geometry to condition model rankings on a task query. The two components serve distinct empirical roles. On a snapshot of 586 models and 14 benchmarks, BoB predicts which models are unusually strong on a held-out task beyond their general ability, reaching a profile correlation of 0.462 compared with 0.049 under equal weighting. It also limits the influence of densely repeated benchmarks on the aggregate. After adding four copies of each benchmark in turn, the resulting rankings retain a Kendall tau of 0.995, compared with 0.936 under equal weighting. The residual field therefore provides task-conditioned prediction, and inverse-density weighting provides robustness to benchmark multiplicity. Together, they turn benchmark-list composition from an incidental property of evaluation suites into an explicit, controllable part of measurement design, providing a principled foundation for task-aware and multiplicity-robust model evaluation.
articles.titleCn: 基准平衡：语义密度重加权，用于基准多样性及任务条件评估
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型通常通过在具有相同权重的基准列表上平均分数来进行比较。这些列表通过在明确的测量设计之外发布而增长，因此等权重将已发布的基准密度转化为隐含的能力权重：密集基准测试的区域会被重复计算。我们引入了基准平衡（BoB），它嵌入基准描述并为每个基准分配一个逆密度语义权重。邻近条目在公开的密度尺度上共享总影响。在将异构分数等价映射到共同潜在尺度之后，残差场使用相同的几何形状来根据任务查询对模型排名进行条件化。这两个组件承担着不同的经验角色。在一个包含586个模型和14个基准的快照中，BoB预测哪些模型在保留的任务上表现出异常强大，超越了它们的一般能力，与等权重下的0.049相比，达到了0.462的轮廓相关性。它还限制了密集重复基准对总体的影响。在依次添加每个基准的四个副本后，结果排名保留了0.995的肯德尔tau系数，而等权重下的肯德尔tau系数为0.936。因此，残差场提供了任务条件预测，而逆密度权重提供了对基准重复性的鲁棒性。结合起来，它们将基准列表的构成从评估套件的偶然属性转变为测量设计的明确可控部分，为任务感知和重复性鲁棒模型评估提供了原则基础。

articles.title: "Act Like a 5th Grader" is Not Enough: Bounding Knowledge in LLM-Based User Simulators
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to simulate human behavior but frequently fail to exhibit realistic cognitive constraints, suffering from a "superhuman bias." Using a dataset of over 71,000 reading comprehension responses from 2,359 primary-school students (grades 4--6), we demonstrate that standard persona prompting yields near-perfect, deterministic performance, failing to capture the natural variance of developing readers. To address this, we introduce the Cognitively Bounded User Simulator (CBUS), an architectural framework that explicitly models the restricted working memory of young readers through an episodic bottleneck. Within this framework, we formalize two distinct test-taking strategies to emulate different reading behaviors. Our evaluation shows that explicitly modeling cognitive bounds significantly narrows the simulation gap across multiple LLM backbones, demonstrating that enforcing architectural constraints is more effective for high-fidelity simulation than simply scaling raw model capabilities.

articles.titleCn: "像五年级学生一样行事"还不够：基于LLM的用户模拟器中的知识边界
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于模拟人类行为，但经常无法表现出真实的认知限制，存在“超人类偏差”。我们使用来自2,359名小学四年级至六年级学生（共71,000多个阅读理解回答）的数据集，证明标准角色提示会产生近乎完美的确定性表现，无法捕捉到发展中读者的自然变化。为解决这一问题，我们引入了认知受限用户模拟器（CBUS），这是一个通过情景瓶颈显式模拟年轻读者有限工作记忆的架构框架。在该框架内，我们定义了两种不同的应试策略来模拟不同的阅读行为。我们的评估表明，显式模拟认知限制显著缩小了多个LLM主干网络之间的模拟差距，证明强制执行架构约束比单纯扩展原始模型能力更有效地实现高保真模拟。

articles.title: Demand-Side Measurement for Generative Engine Optimization: Constructing and Validating a Million-Persona, Intent-Annotated Buyer Corpus
articles.abstract: Generative engines such as ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity answer buyer questions directly and name a shortlist of brands inside the answer. Studying how brands enter or fail to enter that shortlist requires demand-side data: what buyers in a category ask, what information they need, and which sources they trust. Existing large persona corpora are built for training-data diversity and carry neither a staged search-intent label nor a preferred-sources field, so they cannot be joined to supply-side recommendation measurements. We built and validated PersonaGen-1M, a corpus of 1,031,732 synthetic buyer personas spanning 511 industry labels and 4 market contexts, carrying 19,416,821 structured behavioral attributes, 5,160,046 of them search queries. Each persona carries a single primary_intent label covering its query set (78.3% informational, 17.4% commercial, 4.3% transactional) and a preferred_sources field naming the source types that buyer would trust. The corpus was built from roughly 40 million raw persona descriptions drawn from four public datasets through GPU-accelerated MinHash LSH plus semantic deduplication, then enriched to a fixed schema. The intent field selects the commercial-evaluation personas whose queries drive recommendation, and the preferred_sources field pairs against citation-provenance data; that join is the primary intended use, and its controlled empirical estimate is future work. Among million-scale persona corpora surveyed in August 2026, one other carries a source-preference attribute, as a six-value media-channel enum; PersonaGen-1M pairs named per-persona source lists with a staged commercial search-intent label and an attached query set. The full corpus is shared on request for non-commercial research; a stratified subset is published openly so the protocol, the schema and the validation can be inspected and reused without asking us.
articles.titleCn: 面向生成式引擎优化的需求端测量：构建与验证一个百万角色、意图标注的买家语料库
articles.abstractCn: ChatGPT、Gemini和Perplexity等生成式引擎会直接回答买家的提问，并在回答中列出一些品牌。研究品牌如何进入或未能进入该短名单需要需求端数据：即某一品类买家会提出什么问题、需要哪些信息以及他们信任哪些信息来源。现有的庞大用户画像语料库是为了训练数据多样性而构建的，既没有分阶段的搜索意图标签，也没有首选信息来源字段，因此无法与供给侧推荐测量数据进行关联。我们构建并验证了PersonaGen-1M，这是一个包含1031,732个合成买家画像的语料库，涵盖511个行业标签和4个市场环境，包含19,416,821个结构化行为属性，其中5,160,046个是搜索查询。每个画像都有一个单一的主要意图标签，涵盖其查询集（78.3%为信息性意图，17.4%为商业性意图，4.3%为交易性意图），以及一个首选信息来源字段，用于标明买家会信任的信息来源类型。该语料库是从四个公共数据集中通过GPU加速的MinHash LSH和语义去重技术提取约4000万个原始画像描述构建的，然后被丰富到固定模式。意图字段用于筛选驱动推荐的商业评估画像，首选信息来源字段则与引用来源数据进行匹配；这种关联是主要预期用途，其受控的实证估计是未来的工作。在2026年8月调查的百万级画像语料库中，只有另一个语料库包含信息来源偏好属性，作为一个六值媒体渠道枚举；PersonaGen-1M将每个画像的命名信息来源列表与分阶段的商业搜索意图标签和关联的查询集进行匹配。完整语料库在非商业研究请求下共享；一个分层子集公开发布，以便协议、模式和验证过程无需请求即可被检查和复用。

articles.title: Small Language Models as Judges for Rubric-Based Reinforcement Learning
articles.abstract: Rubric-based reinforcement learning extends RL beyond tasks with exact answers or rule-based verifiers by scoring responses against instance-specific criteria. However, this makes reward computation expensive: training requires repeated rubric judging, often with proprietary APIs or local generative LLM judges with 7B parameters or more. We study whether smaller language models can serve as efficient and reliable rubric-based judges. To make this question measurable, we construct PointRubric and RaR-Science-Static, two pointwise rubric-based evaluation datasets with instance-specific criteria and itemwise satisfaction labels. We compare three ways of extracting criterion-level judgments from small models: Generative verdicts, Yes/No Logprob margins, and Probe judges. Across both datasets, the Qwen3-1.7B Probe judge achieves the strongest criterion-level agreement among these methods, outperforming Generative and Logprob judges. Used as a GRPO reward model, it trains a policy from 0.232 to 0.643 on RaR-Science rubric score, compared with 0.594 for an 8B Generative judge baseline, while the baseline requires 10.7$\times$ more reward-judge time. Task and domain transfer experiments further suggest that Probe judges preserve criterion-level reward structure across settings.
articles.titleCn: 基于评分标准的强化学习中小型语言模型的评判作用
articles.abstractCn: 基于标准的强化学习通过将响应与实例特定的标准进行评分，将强化学习扩展到需要精确答案或基于规则的验证器之外的任务。然而，这导致奖励计算成本高昂：训练需要重复的评分判断，通常使用专有API或具有70亿参数或更多的本地生成式大型语言模型作为评分器。我们研究了小型语言模型是否可以作为高效可靠的基于标准的评分器。为了使这个问题可衡量，我们构建了PointRubric和RaR-Science-Static两个基于标准的逐点评估数据集，包含实例特定的标准和项目满足标签。我们比较了三种从小型模型中提取标准级别判断的方法：生成式裁决、是/否对数概率边际和探针评分器。在两个数据集上，Qwen3-1.7B探针评分器在这些方法中实现了最强的标准级别一致性，优于生成式和对数概率评分器。作为GRPO奖励模型使用时，它在RaR-Science评分标准上训练策略从0.232提升到0.643，而8B生成式评分器基线的分数为0.594，但基线需要10.7倍的奖励评分时间。任务和领域迁移实验进一步表明，探针评分器在不同设置中保留了标准级别的奖励结构。

articles.title: Generating Clinical Vignettes that Preserve Cognitive Formulations
articles.abstract: Large language models can generate fluent clinical case vignettes, but fluency alone does not ensure fidelity to a specifiable clinical structure. We introduce FORMA, a theory-grounded framework that compiles a cognitive model of a disorder into a directed weighted graph, samples a person-specific configuration of that graph, and validates whether the generated vignette preserves the specified components and causal links. We instantiate FORMA on Posttraumatic Stress Disorder using the Ehlers and Clark cognitive model, generating 16,500 vignettes across 500 personas, 11 generation models, and three ablation conditions. Evaluation combines an external edge-recovery probe, two clinical experts, a scaled LLM judge, and a clinician user study with 100 licensed practitioners. The cognitive graph is recoverable from full-condition vignettes (MCC = +0.41, AUC = 0.70) but not from zero-shot generation (MCC = +0.01, AUC = 0.50). Experts rate full vignettes substantially higher than zero-shot alternatives, and clinicians perceive them to be human-written 85% of the time, compared with 22% for zero-shot. FORMA also reduces demographic disparity in perceived quality by 1.5-7x. These results show that cognitive formulation can serve as an auditable specification for scalable synthetic clinical text generation. A repository with the data and code is available online: https://github.com/Amit-Oren/FORMA.
articles.comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026. Code and data: https://github.com/Amit-Oren/FORMA
articles.titleCn: 生成保留认知模式的临床案例
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型能够生成流畅的临床案例摘要，但流畅性本身并不能保证其符合特定的临床结构。我们引入了FORMA，这是一个基于理论的框架，将某种疾病的认知模型编译为有向加权图，对图的特定个体配置进行采样，并验证生成的摘要是否保留了指定的组成部分和因果关系。我们使用Ehlers和Clark的认知模型实例化FORMA，在500个个体、11个生成模型和三种消融条件下生成了16500个摘要。评估结合了外部边恢复探测、两位临床专家、一个规模化的大型语言模型评判者，以及一项包含100名持证从业者的临床用户研究。认知图可以从完整条件的摘要中恢复（MCC = +0.41，AUC = 0.70），但无法从零样本生成中恢复（MCC = +0.01，AUC = 0.50）。专家评分完整摘要显著高于零样本替代方案，临床医生85%的时间认为完整摘要是人类撰写的，而零样本仅为22%。FORMA还通过1.5-7倍的倍数减少了感知质量中的群体差异。这些结果表明，认知公式可以作为可审核的规范，用于可扩展的合成临床文本生成。包含数据和代码的存储库已在线发布：https://github.com/Amit-Oren/FORMA。

articles.title: Beyond Fluency: A Rubric-Based Benchmark for Evaluating Saudi Dialect and Cultural Competence in Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed in Arabic-speaking markets, yet standard benchmarks overwhelmingly reward Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) fluency while leaving dialectal and culturally grounded competence unmeasured. This gap is consequential: everyday Arabic is largely dialectal, and dialect encodes social meaning that MSA-centric evaluation cannot capture. We present a rubric-based benchmark for the Saudi dialect, comprising 31 expert-authored prompts spanning idiomatic, pragmatic, lexical, and culturally-embedded phenomena, each paired with an expert-established ground truth. Our methodology separates evaluation into a model-agnostic phase, in which atomic, MECE positive criteria are derived solely from the ground truth, and a model-specific phase, in which four state-of-the-art systems -- Claude Opus 5, Gemini 3.7, GPT-5.6, and Kimi K3 -- are scored against those criteria and penalised for errors they actively introduce. Across 124 model-prompt evaluations we catalogue 466 error instances under a nine-category taxonomy. The four systems cluster within a narrow macro-average band (42.7%-53.1%), with no model exceeding 55% and every model recording at least one negative-scoring prompt, confirming that Saudi dialectal competence remains broadly unsolved. Notably, Ambiguous Framing is the dominant failure mode (37.3% of errors) while outright Hallucination accounts for only 11.2%, indicating that models fail less by stating falsehoods than by distorting register and flattening pragmatic nuance. We further observe a consistency-versus-ceiling trade-off and model-distinctive error signatures. We release the full prompt set, ground truths, and scored rubrics to support reproducible dialectal evaluation.
articles.titleCn: 超越流利度：基于评估标准的沙特方言与文化能力在大语言模型中的基准
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型正日益部署在阿拉伯语市场，但标准基准测试过度侧重现代标准阿拉伯语（MSA）的流畅性，而忽略了方言和文化相关能力的评估。这一差距具有深远影响：日常阿拉伯语主要是方言形式，而方言承载的社会意义是MSA中心评估无法捕捉的。我们提出了一种基于评分标准的沙特方言基准测试，包含31个由专家编写的提示，涵盖习语、语用、词汇和文化嵌入现象，每个提示都配有专家建立的基准答案。我们的方法将评估分为两个阶段：模型无关阶段，其中从基准答案中推导出原子、MECE（相互独立且完全穷尽）的正面标准；模型特定阶段，其中四个最先进的系统——Claude Opus 5、Gemini 3.7、GPT-5.6和Kimi K3——根据这些标准进行评分，并因主动引入的错误受到惩罚。在124次模型-提示评估中，我们根据九类分类法记录了466个错误实例。这四个系统在宏观平均得分上聚集在一个狭窄的范围内（42.7%-53.1%），没有模型超过55%，且每个模型都至少有一个得分较低的提示，证实沙特方言能力仍普遍未解决。值得注意的是，模糊框架是主要的失败模式（占错误的37.3%），而完全的幻觉仅占11.2%，表明模型失败更多是由于扭曲语域和简化语用细节，而非直接陈述虚假信息。我们进一步观察到一致性与上限之间的权衡以及模型特有的错误特征。我们发布完整的提示集、基准答案和评分标准，以支持可重复的方言评估。

articles.title: Evolutionary Soups: Evolving Mixture-of-Experts for Multi-Objective LLM Alignment
articles.abstract: Large language models are increasingly required to generate responses that satisfy multiple competing objectives. Since optimal trade-offs depend on both user preferences and input prompts, controllable multi-objective generation must dynamically adapt models at inference time without retraining. To address this, we propose Evolutionary Soups, a mixture-of-experts framework for fine-grained generation control, with gating networks trained via an evolutionary algorithm. The per-layer gating networks dynamically produce expert-merging coefficients from hidden-state representations, while the evolutionary algorithm incorporates greedy hypervolume contribution for effective evolution of these gating networks, achieving consistent improvements on large and noisy training datasets and broader coverage of the non-convex Pareto front. Experiments across three tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of Evolutionary Soups over baselines: it achieves the best hypervolume, linear utility, and Tchebyshev utility (~20% improvement) among controllable methods on all tasks.
articles.titleCn: 进化汤：进化专家混合体以实现多目标大型语言模型对齐
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型越来越需要生成满足多个竞争目标的回复。由于最佳权衡取决于用户偏好和输入提示，可控多目标生成必须在推理时动态调整模型，而无需重新训练。为此，我们提出了进化汤（Evolutionary Soups），这是一个用于细粒度生成控制的专家混合框架，其门控网络通过进化算法进行训练。每层的门控网络动态地从隐藏状态表示中生成专家合并系数，而进化算法结合贪婪超体积贡献，以有效进化这些门控网络，在大型和嘈杂的训练数据集上实现持续改进，并更广泛地覆盖非凸的帕累托前沿。在三个任务上的实验表明，进化汤比基线方法更有效：它在所有任务中可控方法中实现了最佳超体积、线性效用和切比雪夫效用（改进约20%）。

articles.title: SpanCalib-VLM: Calibrated Hallucination Span Detection in Vision-Language Models
articles.abstract: Detecting hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) requires both accurate span localization and well-calibrated confidence scores. Fine-tuned generative VLMs excel at identifying hallucinated text spans but suffer from overconfidence and high inference latency. Discriminative sequence taggers offer deterministic speed and superior calibration but exhibit conservative span recall. We present SpanCalib-VLM, a hybrid dual-system for the SHROOM-Visions Shared Task that combines a multimodal sequence tagger, consisting of XLM-RoBERTa-Large fused with a SigLIP vision encoder via cross-attention, with our fine-tuned generative VLM (Qwen3.5-4B-SHROOM-SFT). Through a Union-Calibrated Fusion strategy, candidate spans from the generative model are re-scored with calibrated probabilities from the sequence tagger. On the SHROOM-Visions English evaluation split, our ensemble achieves a Pearson calibration correlation of 0.41 and an overall IoU of 0.39, with a clean-response IoU of 0.91} and overall detection accuracy of 70.7%. We make our model weights and code publicly available.
articles.titleCn: SpanCalib-VLM：视觉语言模型中的校准幻觉跨度检测
articles.abstractCn: 在大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）中检测幻觉需要准确的范围定位和经过良好校准的置信度分数。微调的生成式视觉语言模型擅长识别幻觉文本范围，但存在过度自信和高推理延迟的问题。判别式序列标记器提供确定性速度和卓越的校准性能，但表现出保守的范围召回率。我们提出了SpanCalib-VLM，这是一个用于SHROOM-Visions共享任务的混合双系统，它结合了一个多模态序列标记器，该标记器由XLM-RoBERTa-Large与通过交叉注意力融合的SigLIP视觉编码器组成，以及我们微调的生成式视觉语言模型（Qwen3.5-4B-SHROOM-SFT）。通过Union-Calibrated Fusion策略，生成模型的候选范围使用序列标记器提供的校准概率重新评分。在SHROOM-Visions英文评估集上，我们的集成系统实现了0.41的皮尔逊校准相关性、0.39的整体IoU、0.91的干净响应IoU以及70.7%的整体检测准确率。我们公开提供了模型权重和代码。

articles.title: DataFoundry: Evolving Data Preparators via Recursive Self-Improvement
articles.abstract: Domain adaptation of large language models increasingly depends on constructing high-quality training data, yet existing data-preparation pipelines typically address quality only after generation through post-hoc filtering. This creates a fundamental mismatch: data-quality issues often originate from the construction process itself, while quality control is applied only to its outputs. We introduce \textsc{DataFoundry}, a framework for \textbf{evolving data preparators through recursive self-improvement} before large-scale data production. \textsc{DataFoundry} represents a data preparator as an evolvable runtime specification and instantiates its evolution with a \textsc{Skills-as-Modules} architecture, in which a central \textsc{Controller} orchestrates modular skills to compile executable runtimes, diagnose deficiencies on small pilot sets using domain-appropriate criteria, and translate diagnostic feedback into adapters that revise individual preparation components while preserving stable interfaces. We evaluate \textsc{DataFoundry} on DataPrep-Bench across mathematics, finance, law, and medicine, and find that recursively evolved preparators produce training data with higher downstream utility than baselines. Experiments across different backbones further demonstrate that these improvements are not tied to a particular model, while analyses and case studies further reveal the framework's optimization dynamics and illustrate how its evolution unfolds in practice.
articles.titleCn: 数据工厂：通过递归自我改进进化数据准备器
articles.abstractCn: 领域适应的大型语言模型越来越依赖于构建高质量的训练数据，然而现有的数据准备流程通常只在生成后通过事后过滤来处理质量问题。这造成了根本性的不匹配：数据质量问题往往源于构建过程本身，而质量控制仅应用于其输出。我们引入了\textsc{DataFoundry}，这是一个在大规模数据生产前通过递归自我改进来演化数据准备器的框架。\textsc{DataFoundry}将数据准备器表示为一个可演化的运行时规范，并使用\textsc{Skills-as-Modules}架构实例化其演化，其中中央的\textsc{Controller}协调模块化技能来编译可执行运行时，使用领域适当的指标在小规模试点集上诊断缺陷，并将诊断反馈转化为适配器，以修订单个准备组件的同时保持稳定的接口。我们在DataPrep-Bench上对\textsc{DataFoundry}进行了评估，涵盖数学、金融、法律和医学领域，发现递归演化的准备器产生的训练数据在下游效用方面优于基线。跨不同主干网络的实验进一步表明，这些改进并非与特定模型绑定，而分析和案例研究进一步揭示了框架的优化动态，并说明了其演化在实际中的展开方式。

articles.title: Generative vs. Encoder Models for Multilingual NER: A Comprehensive Empirical Study on Naamapadam
articles.abstract: Language is humanity's most consequential technology, yet for over a billion speakers across India's twenty-two constitutionally recognised languages, its digital layer remains structurally incomplete. Named Entity Recognition (NER), the foundational step in transforming raw text into machine-interpretable knowledge, has been studied exhaustively for English but remains largely unsolved across most Indic languages. This paper presents a rigorous comparative study of generative and encoder-based neural architectures for NER on all eleven languages of the Naamapadam benchmark. We evaluate five classic model families spanning sequence-to-sequence transformers and multilingual encoders; four decoder-only large language models (LLMs) fine-tuned with LoRA and 4-bit NF4 quantisation; and nine generative models in zero-to-5-shot inference. Under strict CoNLL span-level evaluation, encoder-based models (mBERT and XLM-R, both F1=0.675 on Hindi) substantially outperform every generative architecture in ten of eleven languages, with gaps of 7.5-40 percentage points against the strongest competitor (Gemma-2-2B: avg F1=0.427). The best few-shot result reaches only 28% of the encoder baseline. We identify three language clusters--encoder-dominant, partial-coverage, and failure-zone; and provide actionable deployment guidelines grounded in transfer learning and low-resource NLP principles.
articles.titleCn: 多语言命名实体识别中的生成式模型与编码器模型：Naamapadam的全面实证研究
articles.abstractCn: 语言是人类最重要的一项技术，然而对于印度宪法承认的22种语言中超过十亿的使用者而言，其数字层面在结构上仍不完整。命名实体识别（NER）是将原始文本转化为机器可理解知识的基础步骤，尽管该技术对英语的研究已十分深入，但在大多数印地语中仍面临巨大挑战。本文对Naamapadam基准测试中所有11种语言的生成式与编码器式神经网络架构的NER进行了严谨的比较研究。我们评估了五种经典模型家族，包括序列到序列转换器和多语言编码器；四种仅使用LoRA和4位NF4量化的解码器式大型语言模型（LLM）；以及九种在零到五次推理中的生成式模型。在严格的CoNLL跨度级评估下，基于编码器的模型（mBERT和XLM-R，在印地语上F1均达到0.675）在十一种语言中的十种中显著优于所有生成式架构，与最强竞争者（Gemma-2-2B：平均F1为0.427）相比，差距达7.5-40个百分点。最佳的少量学习结果仅达到编码器基线的28%。我们识别出三种语言集群——编码器主导型、部分覆盖型和失效区；并基于迁移学习和低资源NLP原则，提供了可操作的部署指南。

articles.title: Detecting Hidden Chain-of-Thought in Large Language Models with Linguistic, Behavioral, and Mechanistic Indicators
articles.abstract: Large language models often answer complex reasoning questions without revealing intermediate steps, raising whether they reason latently or complete patterns. We propose the Hidden CoT Detection Score (HCDS), a comparative behavioral and mechanistic signal measuring whether neutral-prompt behavior aligns more closely with explicit CoT or explicit no- CoT. Here, hidden CoT operationally denotes this neutral-prompt CoT-like alignment; HCDS does not directly observe or prove an unexposed reasoning trace. On GSM8K, HCDS is significantly positive for both Qwen3-4B variants (Thinking $+1.87$, $p = 1.2 \times 10^{-7}$; Instruct $+1.41$, $p = 1.9 \times 10^{-4}$), replicates across a different inference stack and quantization within $0.08$ ($+1.80$ and $+1.45$), and is not significantly positive in seven of eight length-adjusted calibration-control cells. The unadjusted score produces large positive scores on single-step arithmetic and numeric factual lookup. The variants also respond differently to no-CoT instructions: Instruct complies from the prompt alone, whereas Thinking continues reasoning and requires intervention. These findings show stronger, less prompt-conditional CoT-like behavior in the reasoning-tuned model, consistent with but not proof of latent reasoning. HCDS thus investigates latent reasoning without relying on models' self-reported traces.
articles.titleCn: 使用语言、行为和机制指标检测大型语言模型中的隐藏思维链
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型常常在回答复杂推理问题时不揭示中间步骤，引发了它们是进行潜在推理还是完成模式匹配的疑问。我们提出了隐藏思维链检测分数（HCDS），这是一种比较行为和机制信号，用于衡量中性提示行为是否更接近显式思维链（CoT）或显式无思维链（no-CoT）。这里的隐藏思维链操作上指中性提示下的思维链式对齐；HCDS并不直接观察或证明未暴露的推理轨迹。在GSM8K数据集上，HCDS对Qwen3-4B的两个变体均有显著正值（思考$+1.87$，$p = 1.2 \times 10^{-7}$；指令$+1.41$，$p = 1.9 \times 10^{-4}$），在不同推理栈和量化范围内（0.08内，$+1.80$和$+1.45$）均能复制，并且在八分之七的长度调整校准控制单元中未显示显著正值。未调整分数在单步算术和数值事实查询上产生较大的正值。这两个变体对无思维链指令的响应也不同：指令变体仅从提示中遵守，而思考变体继续推理并需要干预。这些结果表明，在推理调优模型中存在更强、更少依赖提示的思维链式行为，这与潜在推理的假设一致，但并非其证明。因此，HCDS在不依赖模型自我报告轨迹的情况下，探究了潜在推理。

articles.title: How Prolific Sellers Self-Present: Dissecting the Communication Patterns of 1.6 Million Reverb Listings
articles.abstract: The current paper draws on self-presentation theory and warranting theory to evaluate how the language patterns in an online marketplace reflect seller status (i.e., a prolific seller versus an everyday seller). Using 1.6 million musical instrument listings from Reverb.com in search of content, style, and structural differences in seller product descriptions, the evidence suggested prolific sellers tend to focus more on objective and functional aspects of a product (e.g., its features and specifications) and less on subjective characteristics like tone, relative to everyday sellers. Prolific sellers also communicated in a more narrative-like style, which was driven by an elevated use of personal pronouns, and they used longer descriptions than everyday sellers. Therefore, what prolific sellers focus on tends to be quite technical, but how they communicate this information is typical of a story that is told to potential buyers. Implications for self-presentation theory and warranting theory are discussed.
articles.titleCn: 如何成功的卖家自我展示：解析160万Reverb商品列表的沟通模式
articles.abstractCn: 本文借鉴自我呈现理论和担保理论，评估在线市场中的语言模式如何反映卖家状态（即，多产卖家与普通卖家）。通过对Reverb.com上160万件乐器商品列表进行内容、风格和结构差异的搜索，证据表明，与普通卖家相比，多产卖家更倾向于关注产品的客观和功能性方面（例如，其特性和规格），而较少关注主观特征，如音色。多产卖家还以更具叙事风格的方式沟通，这得益于个人代词的使用频率提升，并且他们使用的描述比普通卖家更长。因此，多产卖家关注的内容往往非常技术化，但他们传达这些信息的方式则更像是向潜在买家讲述的故事。本文讨论了自我呈现理论和担保理论的启示。

articles.title: XQDT: eXplainable and Quantitative Data-Text Alignment Metric with Feedback Signals
articles.abstract: Evaluating data-text alignment remains challenging: existing metrics often provide limited explanations for the scores, while prompt-based LLM-as-Judge methods can be expensive and unreliable. We present an end-to-end explainable evaluation metric that fine-tunes a language model to identify omitted, extra, incorrect, and correct data units in a data-text pair. These local judgements are aggregated into precision, recall, and F1 scores, providing both fine-grained diagnostic feedback and an interpretable measure of alignment quality. Across benchmarks, our fine-tuned models outperform LLM-as-Judge methods in error prediction and achieve competitive precision, recall, and F1 scores, while maintaining strong correlation with human judgements. Beyond evaluation, our verifier outputs also provide useful feedback signals for downstream correction and refinement, supporting alignment-oriented improvement of data-to-text and text-to-data. Code and resources are available at https://github.com/guihuzhang/xqdt.
articles.titleCn: XQDT：一种具有反馈信号的可解释和定量数据-文本对齐度量
articles.abstractCn: 评估数据-文本对齐仍然具有挑战性：现有的指标通常对分数提供有限的解释，而基于提示的LLM作为评判者的方法可能既昂贵又不可靠。我们提出了一种端到端的可解释评估指标，通过微调语言模型来识别数据-文本对中遗漏、多余、错误和正确的数据单元。这些局部判断被汇总成精确率、召回率和F1分数，既提供细粒度的诊断反馈，也提供对齐质量的可解释度量。在基准测试中，我们微调的模型在错误预测方面优于LLM作为评判者的方法，并实现了具有竞争力的精确率、召回率和F1分数，同时与人类判断保持强相关性。除了评估之外，我们的验证器输出还提供了对下游修正和优化的有用反馈信号，支持数据到文本和文本到数据对齐导向的改进。代码和资源可在https://github.com/guihuzhang/xqdt获取。

articles.title: On the Recoverability of Private Information Unlearning in Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can memorize sensitive information, raising serious privacy concerns. Machine unlearning offers a potential solution to remove such information, but it remains unclear whether existing methods truly erase it or merely hide it within the model. A key challenge is quantifying the persistence of sensitive data under a unified evaluation framework. To address this, we construct a synthetic dataset containing fake private information and propose a white-box auditing framework to systematically assess whether claimed-forgotten information is genuinely removed. Using this framework, we evaluate five existing unlearning methods and find that a simple "inverse greedy" decoding -- selecting the least likely token at each step -- can recover supposedly forgotten private information. Our results reveal that current unlearning approaches often fail to fully eliminate sensitive information, highlighting the need for more reliable methods to ensure privacy in deployed LLMs.
articles.titleCn: 在大语言模型中私有信息去学习的可恢复性
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）能够记忆敏感信息，引发严重的隐私问题。机器脱学提供了一种潜在的解决方案来移除此类信息，但现有方法是否真正擦除它仍不明确，还是仅仅将其隐藏在模型中尚不清楚。一个关键挑战是在统一的评估框架下量化敏感数据的持久性。为解决这一问题，我们构建了一个包含虚假私人信息的合成数据集，并提出了一种白盒审计框架来系统地评估声称已遗忘的信息是否真正被移除。使用该框架，我们评估了五种现有的脱学方法，发现一个简单的“反向贪婪”解码——每一步选择最不可能的标记——能够恢复所谓的已遗忘的私人信息。我们的结果表明，当前的脱学方法往往无法完全消除敏感信息，突显了需要更可靠的方法来确保部署的LLMs中的隐私保护。

articles.title: When Safety Speaks a Language: A Mechanistic Analysis of Safety-Language Identity Entanglement in LLMs
articles.abstract: Safety alignment of large language models (LLMs) degrades across languages, yet the internal mechanism driving this asymmetry remains poorly understood. Our work, therefore, presents a systematic mechanistic analysis of multilingual safety using sparse autoencoder (SAE) features, sparse interpretable directions in the residual stream associated with harmful and harmless model behavior across three instruction-tuned LLMs, eight languages, and all model layers. We observe that safety-relevant features are architecture-dependent in terms of where they are located and how they are distributed across layers. Additionally, they are geometrically entangled with language identity and exhibit cross-lingual sharing patterns, i.e., languages share safety features to varying degrees across model depths and architectures. This safety-language entanglement has direct consequences such that ablating safety features impacts not only harmful response rates but also target language, with the degree of intervention predicted by the relationship between safety and language features. Our findings qualify the language-universality of safety alignment as architecture-dependent and offer a mechanistic account of multilingual safety interventions.
articles.titleCn: 当安全成为一种语言：对大型语言模型中安全语言身份纠缠的机制分析
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的安全对齐在不同语言中表现下降，但驱动这种不对称性的内部机制仍缺乏理解。因此，我们的工作通过稀疏自动编码器（SAE）特征，对多语言安全进行了系统性的机制分析，考察了三个指令调优LLMs、八种语言以及所有模型层中与有害和无害模型行为相关的残差流中的稀疏可解释方向。我们发现，安全相关特征在位置分布上依赖于架构，并且在不同层级间存在分布差异。此外，它们在几何上与语言身份交织，并表现出跨语言的共享模式，即不同语言在模型深度和架构上以不同程度共享安全特征。这种安全与语言的交织具有直接后果，即移除安全特征不仅影响有害响应率，还会影响目标语言，干预程度由安全特征与语言特征之间的关系所预测。我们的研究将安全对齐的语言普适性界定为依赖于架构，并为多语言安全干预提供了机制层面的解释。

articles.title: Compression-Aware Abstention: Teaching LLMs to Refuse When KV-Compression Masks Remove Answer Evidence
articles.abstract: KV-cache compression reduces LLM inference memory by evicting context tokens, but when the evicted tokens contain answer-bearing evidence, the model may hallucinate instead of recognizing that the compressed context is insufficient. We address this failure from a behavioral perspective: to our knowledge, this is the first work to formulate compression-aware abstention as a learning problem, in which a model learns to answer when supporting evidence survives compression and abstain when it does not. We construct supervision from compressor survival masks and tight answer-bearing spans, labeling examples as Confident when evidence survives and Abstain when it is removed. A 10.1M-parameter LoRA adapter trained on ~2.6K MuSiQue 2-hop QA examples reduces base-model hallucinations by 97% under prompt-style truncation while preserving correct answering on evidence-retaining examples. Unlike prompt-only abstention baselines, which over-abstain on many answerable high-retention examples, the trained adapter learns a conditional policy. We also evaluate the method under actual compressed-cache decoding, where multi-compressor training yields a 6-22x relative lift over the unaided base on evidence-retaining examples. Controlled-deletion experiments show that the learned behavior is driven by evidence content rather than input length alone.
articles.comment: 19 pages, 5 figures. Accepted to the GroundLM workshop at EMNLP 2026. Code, adapters, and datasets: https://github.com/mali-kh/compression-aware-abstention
articles.titleCn: 压缩感知弃权：教导大型语言模型在KV压缩掩码移除答案证据时拒绝
articles.abstractCn: KV缓存压缩通过移除上下文标记来减少大语言模型推理内存，但当被移除的标记包含答案相关证据时，模型可能会产生幻觉而不是识别压缩后的上下文不足。我们从行为角度解决这个问题：据我们所知，这是首个将压缩感知拒绝表述为学习问题的工作，其中模型学习在支持证据存活压缩时回答，在证据被移除时不回答。我们根据压缩器存活掩码和紧密的答案相关跨度构建监督，将示例标记为"自信"（当证据存活时）和"拒绝"（当证据被移除时）。一个在~2.6K MuSiQue 2跳问答示例上训练的10.1M参数LoRA适配器，在提示式截断下将基础模型的幻觉减少97%，同时保留了证据保留示例的正确回答。与仅依赖提示的拒绝基线不同，这些基线在许多可回答的高保留示例上过度拒绝，训练的适配器学习了一种条件策略。我们还评估了该方法在实际压缩缓存解码下的表现，其中多压缩器训练在证据保留示例上相对于无辅助基线提升了6-22倍。受控删除实验表明，学习到的行为是由证据内容驱动的，而不仅仅是输入长度。

articles.title: Token Counts Are Not Model Lineage: A Frozen-Threshold Holdout Study of Black-Box LLM API Fingerprinting
articles.abstract: Black-box model attribution is increasingly relevant when large language models (LLMs) are served through relay and reseller APIs. A tempting low-cost signal is the prompt-token count returned by an OpenAI-compatible endpoint: two models that share a tokenizer and chat template may produce the same count sequence up to a fixed offset. Yet the validity of this signal for broader \emph{model-family} attribution has received little direct holdout testing. We conduct a frozen-threshold study over 24 labeled endpoint pairs, split evenly into a development set and an untouched holdout set, with three temporal repeats and 30 controlled texts per pair. We introduce a validity-gated result contract that distinguishes an observed dissimilarity from an uninformative measurement caused by missing usage data, rate limits, or endpoint policy. The resulting shift-invariant exact-match score perfectly separates the 12 development pairs, yielding a frozen threshold of 0.725. On holdout, however, only 6 of 12 pairs are eligible under the pre-specified three-repeat rule. Among eligible pairs, balanced accuracy is 0.75, sensitivity is 0.50 (95\% Wilson interval 0.15--0.85), and specificity is 1.00 (0.342--1.00). Two same-family pairs---Qwen 3.8 and DeepSeek V4 variants---fall below the frozen threshold. Across 4,320 formal API calls, every log is replayable, while holdout contains 189 non-200 responses and 157 successful responses without prompt-token usage. The study therefore validates token-count consistency as a fingerprint of a shared \emph{tokenization stack}, but rejects its use as a standalone necessary test for model-family lineage.
articles.titleCn: 模型谱系并非标记计数：黑盒LLM API指纹识别的冻结阈值留出研究
articles.abstractCn: 当大型语言模型（LLM）通过中继和分销API提供服务时，黑盒模型归因的重要性日益凸显。一个诱人的低成本信号是OpenAI兼容端点返回的提示令牌计数：两个共享分词器和聊天模板的模型可能产生相同的计数序列，直到一个固定的偏移量。然而，这种信号对于更广泛的\emph{模型家族}归因的有效性尚未得到直接的保留测试。我们对24对标记端点进行了冻结阈值研究，平均分为开发集和未受影响的保留集，包含三次时间重复和每对30个控制文本。我们引入了一个有效性门控结果合约，以区分观察到的差异与因缺失使用数据、速率限制或端点策略导致的无信息测量。结果产生的平移不变精确匹配分数完美地区分了12个开发对，得出冻结阈值为0.725。但在保留集上，只有12对中的6对符合预先指定的三次重复规则。在符合条件的对中，平衡精度为0.75，灵敏度（95%威尔逊区间）为0.50（0.15--0.85），特异度（0.342--1.00）为1.00。两个同家族对——Qwen 3.8和DeepSeek V4变体——低于冻结阈值。在4,320次正式API调用中，每个日志都可以重放，而保留集包含189个非200响应和157个未使用提示令牌的成功响应。因此，该研究验证了令牌计数一致性是共享\emph{分词堆栈}的指纹，但拒绝将其作为模型家族谱系独立必要测试的使用。

articles.title: Sleight of Word Benchmark: Can Language Models Notice If Their Own Output Was Tampered With?
articles.abstract: The output of a Language Model can be tampered with \emph{while} the model is writing it. A simple test can thus be constructed by evaluating the model's perception of this external perturbation. In this spirit, a simple benchmark is built in which a single word is consistently substituted with another in the generation process. We call this method \emph{Sleight of Word}. Two distinct axes are measured: metrics that relate to the model's surprise, as well as an evaluation of the textual reaction for 19 different open-weight language models.
articles.titleCn: 灵巧措辞基准测试：语言模型能否察觉自己的输出是否被篡改？
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型的输出可以在模型生成它的过程中被篡改。因此，可以通过评估模型对外部扰动的感知来构建一个简单的测试。在此精神下，我们构建了一个简单的基准测试，在生成过程中始终用一个词替换另一个词。我们称这种方法为“Sleight of Word”。测量了两个不同的维度：与模型惊讶程度相关的指标，以及对19种不同开放权重语言模型的文本反应评估。

articles.title: IndicDetect: Evaluating Cross-Lingual LLM-Generated Text Detection for Hindi, Telugu, and Tamil
articles.abstract: The rapid proliferation of LLMs has further heightened the need to develop dependable AI-generated text detection, especially beyond English. Nevertheless, current benchmarks pay little attention to Indic languages and test detectors in idealized settings that do not represent the real world. We present a generalized benchmark for AI-generated text detection in Hindi, Telugu, and Tamil, which we call IndicDetect, designed to assess the robustness of detectors under realistic distribution shifts. IndicDetect comprises highly curated human-written texts matched with LLM-generated counterparts across various domains and generators, and systematically evaluates detectors in the presence of domain shift, generator shift, and adversarial perturbation. Using a single and repeatable evaluation scheme, we evaluate a wide range of statistical and neural detectors. We find substantial robustness failures: supervised neural detectors perform well in-distribution, while training-free methods degrade considerably under unseen generators and adversarial attacks. The severity of these failures varies across languages, with Hindi exhibiting the largest overall degradation under adversarial perturbations. These results highlight that the primary weakness of existing detectors in Indic settings lies in their robustness, not in their peak accuracy. IndicDetect provides standard data splits, an evaluation protocol, and baselines to establish a robust, language-aware foundation for AI-generated text detection in Indic scripts.
articles.titleCn: IndicDetect：评估印地语、泰卢固语和泰米尔语跨语言LLM生成文本检测
articles.abstractCn: LLMs的快速普及进一步凸显了开发可靠的人工智能生成文本检测技术的需求，尤其是在英语之外的语言领域。然而，当前的基准测试很少关注印地语系语言，且在并非真实世界的理想化环境中测试检测器。我们提出了一个通用的基准测试，用于检测印地语、泰卢固语和泰米尔语的AI生成文本，称之为IndicDetect，旨在评估检测器在现实分布偏移情况下的鲁棒性。IndicDetect包含经过精心筛选的人类书写文本，与跨不同领域和生成器的LLM生成文本相匹配，并系统地评估检测器在领域偏移、生成器偏移和对抗性扰动存在时的表现。通过单一且可重复的评估方案，我们评估了广泛的统计和神经检测器。我们发现存在显著的鲁棒性失效：监督神经检测器在分布内表现良好，而无需训练的方法在未见过的生成器和对抗性攻击下性能大幅下降。这些失效的严重程度因语言而异，其中印地语在对抗性扰动下表现出最大的整体退化。这些结果表明，现有检测器在印地语环境中的主要弱点在于其鲁棒性，而非峰值精度。IndicDetect提供了标准数据分割、评估协议和基线，旨在为印地文字符的AI生成文本检测建立鲁棒、语言感知的基础。

articles.title: When Less is More: Understanding When Token Filtering Helps and Fails in AI-generated Text Detection
articles.abstract: The rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) has made AI-generated text detection increasingly critical. Existing zero-shot detectors assume that more token-level evidence leads to more reliable detection. However, our empirical study challenges this consensus: fewer tokens sometimes work better, retaining only 40% can yield optimal performance, yet this benefit is not universal. Using the Entropy Gap Score (EGS), we introduce top-$k$ cumulative probability filtering as a diagnostic probe. Across three representative settings, filtering exhibits strikingly different behaviors. We analyze EGS via typical set theory and quantify its dynamics through entropy calibration and distribution analysis. We find that filtering helps for weak source LMs, where low-entropy tokens are harmful, but fails for strong source LMs, where they are not notably harmful. Our work provides the first systematic analysis showing that some tokens are not merely uninformative but systematically harmful due to entropy miscalibration, revealing a two-sided trade-off in token-level detection.
articles.titleCn: 当少即是多：理解在AI生成文本检测中，令牌过滤何时有效和失效
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）的快速进展使得AI生成文本检测日益关键。现有零样本检测器假设更多的token级证据能带来更可靠的检测。然而，我们的实证研究挑战了这一共识：较少的token有时效果更好，仅保留40%即可获得最佳性能，但这一优势并非普遍存在。我们使用熵差分分数（EGS），引入了top-k累积概率过滤作为诊断探针。在三个代表性场景中，过滤表现出截然不同的行为。我们通过典型集理论分析EGS，并通过熵校准和分布分析量化其动态。我们发现，过滤对弱源LLM有帮助，因为低熵token有害，但对强源LLM无效，因为它们并非显著有害。我们的工作首次系统性地表明，某些token不仅无信息量，还因熵误校准而系统性地有害，揭示了token级检测中的双向权衡。

articles.title: REIGN: Refurbished Embeddings with Integrated Guidance Networks for Efficient Context-Length Scaling
articles.abstract: Dense retrieval over long documents is expensive. Token-level encoders scale quadratically in sequence length, and most long-context embedding models reach 32K tokens only through architectural workarounds or by stretching billion-parameter LLMs. We propose REIGN (Refurbished Embeddings with Integrated Guidance Networks), a contrastively trained bi-encoder that operates on sequences of contextualised chunk embeddings from a frozen Guidance Network (GN) rather than on raw tokens. REIGN targets multi-chunk inputs, primarily for document-to-document retrieval; single-chunk inputs stay with the GN. Decoupling token-level processing from document-level reasoning, and caching the GN embeddings to disk, cuts per-document training cost by roughly four orders of magnitude relative to chunked Transformer fine-tuning. We also release a synthetic long-document retrieval benchmark for contrastive training and evaluation at long context lengths. Across an in-distribution Wikipedia benchmark, the LoCo out-of-distribution suite, and a real-world patent retrieval case study, REIGN matches dense long-context retrievers at smaller parameter budgets in each regime. A paired significance test puts it on par with models 1.6-4.3x larger on the patent task, and it stays within 0.65 nDCG@10 of a 20x-larger model on LoCo.

articles.titleCn: REIGN：集成指导网络的翻新嵌入，用于高效上下文长度扩展
articles.abstractCn: 长文档的密集检索成本高昂。基于token的编码器在序列长度上呈平方级扩展，大多数长上下文嵌入模型仅通过架构上的变通或拉伸数十亿参数的大型语言模型才能达到32K个token。我们提出了REIGN（集成指导网络的翻新嵌入），这是一种对比训练的双编码器，它基于冻结的指导网络（GN）生成的上下文化块嵌入序列进行操作，而不是基于原始token。REIGN主要针对多块输入，主要用于文档到文档的检索；单块输入则由GN处理。将token级处理与文档级推理解耦，并将GN嵌入缓存到磁盘上，与分块Transformer微调相比，每文档训练成本降低了约四个数量级。我们还发布了一个用于长上下文长度对比训练和评估的合成长文档检索基准。在分布内维基百科基准、LoCo分布外套件以及一个真实的专利检索案例研究中，REIGN在每个场景下均以更小的参数预算匹配了密集长上下文检索器。配对显著性测试表明，在专利任务上，其表现与参数规模大1.6-4.3倍的模型相当，并且在LoCo上，其nDCG@10与参数规模大20倍的模型差距保持在0.65以内。

articles.title: When History Is Multimodal: Rethinking Context Management for Long-Horizon Agents
articles.abstract: Long-horizon agents need a context manager to compress growing interaction histories into a bounded working context, via passive strategies or active strategies that decide how memory is accessed and reorganized. Meanwhile, prior optical-memory work mainly treats pixels as a dense codec for textualized histories, often presupposing that rendering context into optical memory incurs a significant performance drop relative to text, thus coupling this representation with SFT, self-distillation, or reinforcement learning to close this gap, leaving unresolved (i) how visual rendering performs as a context manager under a fair, controlled comparison, and (ii) whether this carrier offers a native advantage when history is inherently multimodal. In this paper, we formulate context management as a budget-constrained history transformation and introduce Visual Rendering (VR) as a representational context manager. Under a shared harness, policy model, trigger, and task domain, we evaluate VR on four text-centric and three multimodal benchmarks against four baselines (No Compression, Discard-All, Sliding Window, Summarization), finding visual memory is a natural carrier of native visual evidence. Building on this finding, we propose VERA (Visual Evidence-Retaining strategy for long-horizon Agents), a training-free context manager built on deterministic rendering with no exposed memory operations: on text-centric benchmarks it renders textual history as VR does, while on multimodal benchmarks it retains native visual observations instead of translating them into text. Across nearly all benchmarks, VERA cuts cumulative non-cache tokens by 31.5%-63.1% versus No Compression, matches existing managers on text-centric tasks, and achieves the highest accuracy among all baselines on multimodal tasks, supporting a modality-preserving view of long-horizon context management.
articles.titleCn: 当历史是多模态时：重新思考长时程智能体的情境管理
articles.abstractCn: 长时程智能体需要一个上下文管理器来将不断增长的交互历史压缩到有限的工作上下文中，通过被动策略或主动策略来决定如何访问和重组记忆。与此同时，之前的光存储工作主要将像素视为文本化历史的密集编解码器，通常预设将渲染上下文转化为光存储相对于文本会导致显著的性能下降，因此将这种表示与SFT（自蒸馏）、自蒸馏或强化学习相结合来弥补这一差距，但未解决（i）在公平、受控的比较下视觉渲染作为上下文管理器的表现如何，以及（ii）当历史本质上多模态时，这种载体是否提供原生优势。在本文中，我们将上下文管理定义为受预算限制的历史转换，并引入视觉渲染（VR）作为表示性上下文管理器。在共享的框架、策略模型、触发器和任务域下，我们在四个以文本为中心和三个多模态基准上评估VR，与四个基线（无压缩、丢弃所有、滑动窗口、摘要）进行比较，发现视觉记忆是原生视觉证据的自然载体。基于这一发现，我们提出了VERA（视觉证据保留策略，用于长时程智能体），这是一种基于确定性渲染且无暴露内存操作的、无需训练的上下文管理器：在以文本为中心的基准上，它像VR一样渲染文本历史，而在多模态基准上，它保留原生视觉观察结果而不是将它们翻译成文本。在几乎所有基准上，VERA与无压缩相比减少了31.5%-63.1%的累积非缓存token，在以文本为中心的任务上与现有管理器相当，并在多模态任务中实现了所有基线中最高的准确率，支持了长时程上下文管理的模态保留观点。

articles.title: En-ViMedNER: An English-Vietnamese Parallel Biomedical Corpus with UMLS Semantic Type Annotations
articles.abstract: Biomedical Named Entity Recognition (NER) is fundamental to healthcare AI applications, including clinical decision support and medical information extraction. While corpora with Unified Medical Language System (UMLS) annotations, such as MedMentions, have driven progress in English biomedical NER, no comparable resource exists for Vietnamese. This paper presents En-ViMedNER, the first English-Vietnamese parallel biomedical NER corpus annotated with UMLS semantic types, which are language-neutral codes providing a shared cross-lingual label space and ensuring direct comparability with existing UMLS-based resources. The corpus contains 4,392 PubMed abstract pairs, 44,892 English-Vietnamese sentence pairs, and 202,949 aligned entity-mention pairs across 21 semantic types adapted from the MedMentions ST21pv dataset. To balance quality and scalability, we have constructed the corpus through automatic translation, expert post-editing, LLM-assisted label projection, and human verification and adjudication. We characterize En-ViMedNER as a large-scale silver-standard corpus with a human-audited and consensus-corrected mini-test subset. We evaluate En-ViMedNER in two settings: (i) Vietnamese-input/Vietnamese-output biomedical NER and (ii) English-input/Vietnamese-output cross-lingual NER. For Vietnamese NER, we benchmark Vietnamese-supervised encoder models, English-supervised multilingual encoder models, and prompt-based LLMs. The best model achieves an F1 score of 52.70 on the test set and 53.78 on the mini-test set. For cross-lingual NER, we benchmark encoder-decoder models and prompt-based LLMs. The best model achieves an F1 score of 45.44 on the mini-test set. We publicly release our corpus, corpus construction pipeline, and baseline models to facilitate future Vietnamese biomedical NLP research.

articles.titleCn: En-ViMedNER：一个带有UMLS语义类型标注的英越平行生物医学语料库
articles.abstractCn: 生物医学命名实体识别（NER）是医疗保健人工智能应用的基础，包括临床决策支持和医疗信息提取。虽然具有统一医学语言系统（UMLS）标注语料库（如MedMentions）推动了英语生物医学NER的发展，但越南语尚无类似资源。本文介绍了En-ViMedNER，这是首个英越平行生物医学NER语料库，使用UMLS语义类型标注，这些语言中立代码提供了一个共享的跨语言标签空间，并确保与现有基于UMLS的资源直接可比。该语料库包含4,392对PubMed摘要、44,892对英越句子以及来自MedMentions ST21pv数据集的21种语义类型对齐的202,949对实体提及。为了平衡质量和可扩展性，我们通过自动翻译、专家后编辑、LLM辅助标签投影以及人工验证和裁决构建了该语料库。我们将En-ViMedNER表征为一个大型的银标语料库，并包含一个经过人工审核和共识修正的小型测试子集。我们在两种设置下评估了En-ViMedNER：（i）越南语输入/越南语输出的生物医学NER和（ii）英语输入/越南语输出的跨语言NER。对于越南语NER，我们基准测试了越南语监督编码器模型、英语监督多语言编码器模型和基于提示的LLM。最佳模型在测试集上达到52.70的F1分数，在小型测试集上达到53.78。对于跨语言NER，我们基准测试了编码器-解码器模型和基于提示的LLM。最佳模型在小型测试集上达到45.44的F1分数。我们公开发布了我们的语料库、语料库构建流程和基线模型，以促进未来的越南语生物医学NLP研究。

articles.title: VibeJam: A User Study Platform for Web Development with Agents
articles.abstract: Programming with AI is increasingly agentic, users prompt LLMs to directly edit their code and review the changes, with adoption growing especially for web development tasks. Despite this growth, most NLP work uses offline evaluation and lacks support for online studies, losing insights into how programmers truly use coding agents. We release VibeJam, a browser-based user study platform for users to collaborate with AI agents to develop websites. VibeJam enables agent customization and uses the open-source Aider agent by default, and to mirror downstream use, we add diff review, chat and plan modes, and live website previews. In a pilot study with 55 released, game-based website creation tasks, five experienced AI programmers rate our system as fun, simple, and resembling commercial tools, while 13 junior students use VibeJam to make websites of higher quality than agents in the same task. We open-source VibeJam to spur extensions and support studies on how coding agents can help users.
articles.titleCn: VibeJam：一个用于Web开发的带代理的用户研究平台
articles.abstractCn: 使用AI编程正变得越来越自主化，用户通过提示让大型语言模型直接编辑他们的代码并审查更改，尤其是在网页开发任务上的采用增长显著。尽管如此，大多数自然语言处理工作使用离线评估，缺乏对在线研究的支持，从而失去了洞察程序员如何真正使用编码代理的机会。我们发布了VibeJam，这是一个基于浏览器的用户研究平台，让用户能够与AI代理合作开发网站。VibeJam支持代理定制，并默认使用开源的Aider代理，为了模拟下游使用情况，我们添加了差异审查、聊天和计划模式，以及实时网站预览功能。在一项包含55个已发布的、基于游戏的网站创建任务的试点研究中，五位经验丰富的AI程序员将我们的系统评为有趣、简单且类似于商业工具，而13名初级学生使用VibeJam制作的网站质量高于同一任务中的代理。我们开源了VibeJam，以促进扩展并支持研究编码代理如何帮助用户。

articles.title: Check The Scoreboard: An Analysis of Scoring Schemes on Multiple-Choice Evaluation
articles.abstract: Multiple-choice question answering (MCQA) benchmarks in NLP use number-right scoring (accuracy), but in educational testing, the scoring scheme, the combination of the response mode models follow and the rule for grading responses, is a key design choice that dictates which abilities to reward. We examine how alternatives to number right change what MCQA measures with six education-inspired schemes that assess abilities beyond accuracy: distractor elimination, abstention, confidence calibration, and self-correction. On LLM benchmarks, these schemes: 1) shift rankings of 31 LLMs beyond rephrased number right prompts; 2) better predict the LLMs users prefer in LLM Arena; and 3) reveal distinct model capabilities, like that GPT-5 rarely abstains and readily self-corrects, while weaker open-weight models often abstain and hesitate to eliminate choices. Given the benefits of alternative scoring schemes, we discuss ways to extend them to tasks beyond MCQA.
articles.titleCn: 检查计分板：对多项选择题评估计分方案的分析
articles.abstractCn: 自然语言处理（NLP）中的多项选择题回答（MCQA）基准采用正确率评分（准确率），但在教育测试中，评分方案、响应模式模型的组合以及评分规则是关键的设计选择，它们决定了哪些能力会得到奖励。我们通过六个受教育启发的方案来检验替代正确率评分如何改变MCQA的衡量标准，这些方案评估了超越准确率的能力：干扰项排除、弃权、置信度校准和自我纠正。在大型语言模型（LLM）基准上，这些方案：1）改变了31个LLM在重新措辞的正确率提示下的排名；2）更好地预测了LLM竞技场中用户偏好的LLM；3）揭示了不同的模型能力，例如GPT-5很少弃权且乐于自我纠正，而较弱的开放权重模型则常弃权且犹豫不决地排除选项。鉴于替代评分方案的优势，我们讨论了将其扩展到MCQA之外任务的方法。

articles.title: Improving Argument Saliency Coverage in Small LLMs for Long Legal Opinion Summarization via Sequence-Level Distillation
articles.abstract: We show that sequence-level distillation from a capable long-context teacher model is a simple, annotation-free, and data-efficient strategy for improving argument saliency coverage in long legal opinion summarization, where small LLMs often struggle to retain the most salient argumentative content. Across student model sizes, distillation consistently surpasses tuning on expert-written summaries in our legal-opinion setting. We further demonstrate that most gains are achieved with as few as ~10 training summaries, highlighting the strong data efficiency of teacher-generated supervision. Finally, we find that summary distillation is sufficient for improvements: reasoning-chain distillation remains competitive with summary-only distillation, but provides marginal benefit when combined with summary supervision.
articles.titleCn: 通过序列级蒸馏提升小型LLM在长法律意见摘要中的论点显著性覆盖
articles.abstractCn: 我们证明了从强大的长上下文教师模型中进行序列级蒸馏是一种简单、无需标注且数据高效的策略，用于提高长法律意见摘要中论点显著性覆盖率的改善，其中小型LLM通常难以保留最显著的论辩内容。在我们的法律意见设置中，蒸馏始终超越了对专家编写的摘要进行微调。我们进一步证明，使用仅~10个训练摘要即可实现大部分收益，突显了教师生成的监督的强数据效率。最后，我们发现摘要蒸馏足以实现改进：推理链蒸馏与摘要蒸馏保持竞争力，但在与摘要监督结合时仅提供边际收益。

articles.title: ManGo: Manga Active Narrative Grounding Optimization
articles.abstract: Manga visual question answering requires models to answer questions over panel-based visual narratives, where relevant evidence is distributed across ordered panels, embedded text, recurring characters, and implicit event transitions. This structure makes passive page encoding insufficient, as the model must identify which panels to inspect, what clues to retain, and when the accumulated evidence is sufficient for answering. We propose ManGo (Manga Active Narrative Grounding Optimization), an unsupervised framework for active manga visual question answering. ManGo introduces Active Narrative Sketching (ANS), which iteratively selects panels, extracts concise grounded clues, and decides when to stop, forming a compact question-directed evidence sketch before answer generation. To optimize this behavior without human-annotated answers or rationale paths, ManGo samples multiple ANS rollouts and applies group-relative training with two rewards: answer preference from listwise self-ranking and path consistency from stable ordered panel trajectories. The combined reward is optimized with group-relative policy training, encouraging the model to improve both final answers and the panel-level evidence paths that support them. Experiments on standard manga understanding benchmarks show that ManGo achieves state-of-the-art performance across different settings.
