articles.titleCn: LLM 评分员作为评分者：一项关于严重性、光环效应、可靠性和版本不稳定性在公共语料库上 LLM 论文评分的预注册审计
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在学习分析中越来越多地被用作作文评分器，其评估几乎完全依赖于一致性统计。教育测量学警告称，评分者之间也存在严苛程度差异、光环效应以及作为工具的漂移现象。我们将LLM评分者视为评分员，并在两种语言（ENEM/巴西作文；ASAP）的公共语料库上运行预先注册的评分者效应测试套件（多面Rasch严苛度、残差光环、普遍性/决策研究、跨版本变化、差异功能）：2,377篇作文、12位评分员、4个提供者、5个版本对比、重复单元，以分数张量形式发布。评分员严苛度在ENEM的0-1000分制上跨越219个点；在ASAP上，评分小组的分数范围占15-33%，而训练人类之间的差距接近1%。评分员与人类的相关性处于0.47-0.56的不区分区间。所有五个版本对比都使严苛度超出家族置换的零假设（高达133分），并且一位评分员在研究期间被淘汰，通过身份示警鸟识别出来。两项预先注册的测试返回了诚实的零假设：调整严苛度的排行榜逆转未能通过置换零假设，并且“沉默漂移”被证伪：在五个对比中的四个中，一致性随严苛度变化。重复实验产生了自洽性（当k≤2时，φ≥0.80），但并非人类水平的准确性，并且同一工具检查推翻了我们自己的光环比较：在匹配工具和校准后，我们发现没有可信证据表明评分员的光环效应超过训练人类范围。

articles.title: CoCoA: Context-Conditional Cultural Alignment for Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) often favor Western-associated entities across cultural contexts. Conventional debiasing methods aim for uniform neutrality, but cultural bias mitigation demands context-conditional behavior, preferring culturally appropriate entities when cultural cues are present and remaining neutral when they are absent. We propose CoCoA (Context-Conditional Cultural Alignment), a framework that learns this behavior through dual-context training on the same entity pairs under contexts with and without cultural cues. CoCoA combines a contrastive alignment objective with calibration and drift regularization, optimized through goal-aware gradient reconciliation. We evaluate CoCoA on CAMeL and Camellia, two entity-centric cultural bias benchmarks, across ten language settings and four LLMs. CoCoA reduces the Cultural Bias Score from 43 to 24 on average while maintaining near-neutral preferences at 50.2, with minimal impact on general performance across five standard benchmarks. These findings highlight that effective cultural alignment requires context-conditional modeling rather than uniform debiasing, and establish a new direction for mitigating entity-centric cultural bias in LLMs.

articles.titleCn: CoCoA：面向大型语言模型的情境条件文化对齐
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在跨文化背景下往往倾向于与西方相关的实体。传统的去偏方法旨在实现均一的中立性，但文化偏见缓解需要条件化行为，即在存在文化线索时倾向于文化上合适的实体，在不存在时保持中立。我们提出了CoCoA（条件性文化对齐）框架，该框架通过在具有和缺乏文化线索的相同实体对上进行双重上下文训练来学习这种行为。CoCoA结合了对比对齐目标、校准和漂移正则化，并通过目标感知梯度协调进行优化。我们在CAMeL和Camellia两个以实体为中心的文化偏见基准测试上，针对十个语言环境和四个LLMs评估了CoCoA。CoCoA平均将文化偏见分数从43降至24，同时保持在50.2的近似中性偏好，且对五个标准基准测试的整体性能影响极小。这些发现表明，有效的文化对齐需要条件化建模而非均一去偏，并为缓解LLMs中的以实体为中心的文化偏见开辟了新方向。

articles.title: GeoAgent: Evaluating VLM Geolocalization Through Embodied Navigation
articles.abstract: Modern Vision-Language Models (VLMs) perform well above the human baseline in image geolocalization, a task critically important in disaster response, OSINT verification, and location privacy. However, most efforts to study AI behavior on the task remain limited to static image-based retrieval, classification, and predictions. We argue that faithful recreation of the task should involve embodied navigation, where a multimodal agent autonomously explores its surroundings to gather observations before submitting a prediction. To this end, we introduce \textbf{GeoAgent}, an agentic environment-based benchmark that requires agents to navigate Street View environments to refine their geolocalization through sequential reasoning. Our analysis shows that modern VLMs struggle to discern regional patterns while succeeding at country- and continent-level predictions. When compared to static image-based baselines, agentic navigation significantly improves accuracy across established metrics. We also note severe bias in a developed/developing region context across frontier model architectures and poor self-improvement capabilities given incorrect priors. Overall, our work establishes the challenges of embodied navigation and geospatial reasoning. We publicly release our code and the GeoAgent environment: https://geoagent-benchmark.github.io
articles.titleCn: GeoAgent：通过具身导航评估视觉语言模型的地理定位
articles.abstractCn: 现代视觉语言模型（VLMs）在图像地理定位任务上的表现显著优于人类基准，这一任务在灾害响应、开源情报验证和位置隐私保护方面至关重要。然而，目前研究AI在该任务上的行为大多局限于静态图像的检索、分类和预测。我们认为，忠实再现该任务应涉及具身导航，即多模态智能体自主探索周围环境以收集观察结果，然后提交预测。为此，我们引入了\textbf{GeoAgent}，这是一个基于环境的智能体基准，要求智能体在街景环境中导航，通过序列推理来完善其地理定位能力。我们的分析表明，现代VLMs难以识别区域模式，但在国家和大陆级别的预测上表现成功。与静态图像基准相比，具身导航显著提高了各项既定指标上的准确率。我们还注意到，在发达/发展中地区背景下，前沿模型架构普遍存在严重偏见，且在给定错误先验信息时，自我改进能力较差。总体而言，我们的工作确立了具身导航和地理空间推理的挑战。我们公开发布了我们的代码和GeoAgent环境：https://geoagent-benchmark.github.io

articles.title: SIC-Agents: Benchmarking and Building an Adaptive Simulator for Pediatric Serious Illness Communication Training
articles.abstract: Pediatric serious illness communication (SIC) is critically important, yet scalable communication training for clinicians remains limited. Compared with other dialogue simulation settings, pediatric SIC poses additional challenges, including multi-party interactions, response to parental distress and strong dependence on feedback dynamics. Existing LLM-based simulators optimize generic dialogue quality rather than curriculum-contingent behavior required for effective SIC training. In collaboration with educators and pediatric clinicians, we introduce the first benchmark suite and simulation framework tailored to pediatric SIC training. Our benchmarks, PitfallBench and DialogueBench, evaluate simulators both at the turn-level and across full dialogues. We further propose SIC-Agents, a self-improving framework that generates a clinician-editable skill document to guide simulator behavior. Our experiments show that SIC-Agents outperforms static expert prompting. To support future research, we release our benchmarks for parent simulation in pediatric SIC at https://github.com/Beikewzh/sic-benchmarks
articles.titleCn: SIC智能体：儿科重症疾病沟通培训的基准测试与自适应模拟器构建
articles.abstractCn: 儿科重症疾病沟通（SIC）至关重要，然而针对临床医生的规模化沟通培训仍然有限。与其他对话模拟场景相比，儿科SIC面临着额外的挑战，包括多方互动、对家长痛苦的回应以及高度依赖反馈动态。现有的基于大型语言模型的模拟器优化的是通用对话质量，而非有效SIC培训所需的课程相关行为。我们与教育者和儿科临床医生合作，推出了首个专为儿科SIC培训设计的基准套件和模拟框架。我们的基准测试套件PitfallBench和DialogueBench，在回合级别和完整对话层面评估模拟器。我们进一步提出了SIC-Agents，这是一个自我改进框架，生成临床医生可编辑的技能文档来指导模拟器行为。实验表明，SIC-Agents优于静态专家提示。为支持未来研究，我们在https://github.com/Beikewzh/sic-benchmarks上发布了用于儿科SIC家长模拟的基准测试。

articles.title: MUDDLE: Measuring Understanding of Documents under Distractor and Length Effects
articles.abstract: Document question-answering systems increasingly answer questions over collections of retrieved documents rather than one clean source, so robustness to distracting context matters as much as reading ability. When such systems fail, it is often unclear whether the context was too long or the distractors were too close to the topic, because prior work tends to conflate these two effects. We present MUDDLE, a controlled benchmark that separates them. MUDDLE uses 270 human-annotated questions, each tied to a single source document, and instantiates every question in five conditions: the source alone, the source with two or four topically similar hard negatives, and the source with two or four random distractors. The random distractors are matched to the hard negatives in length and provenance, so an accuracy gap between the two arms reflects topical similarity rather than length. All five conditions are rendered in markdown, page images, and raw PDF, but the distractor sweep reported here is run in markdown, since a source plus its distractors exceeds current image and PDF input limits. We score answers with an LLM judge across three model families. In the complete markdown sweep, hard negatives lower accuracy more than length-matched random documents at both context sizes for gpt-5-mini, while random documents stay near the no-distractor baseline. The effect is small but directionally consistent, and for gpt-5-mini hard negatives significantly underperform length-matched random distractors when pooled across context sizes. We release the data and evaluation code for a reproducible study of context degradation.

articles.titleCn: 在干扰因素和长度效应下衡量对文档的理解：MUDDLE
articles.abstractCn: 文档问答系统越来越多地基于检索到的文档集合来回答问题，而不是单一纯净的来源，因此对干扰性上下文的鲁棒性重要性与阅读能力同等重要。当这类系统失效时，通常不清楚是上下文过长还是干扰项与主题过于接近，因为以往的研究往往将这两种效应混淆。我们提出了MUDDLE，一个可控制的基准测试，用于将它们区分开来。MUDDLE使用270个人类标注的问题，每个问题都与单个来源文档相关联，并将每个问题实例化为五种条件：仅来源文档、来源文档加上两个或四个主题相似的硬负样本，以及来源文档加上两个或四个随机干扰项。随机干扰项与硬负样本在长度和来源上相匹配，因此两个分支之间的准确率差距反映了主题相似性，而不是长度。所有五种条件都以markdown、页面图像和原始PDF格式呈现，但这里报告的干扰项扫描是在markdown中运行的，因为来源文档及其干扰项超过了当前图像和PDF输入限制。我们使用LLM裁判在三个模型系列中对答案进行评分。在完整的markdown扫描中，对于gpt-5-mini，硬负样本在两种上下文长度下都比长度匹配的随机文档更显著地降低了准确率，而随机文档则保持在无干扰项的基线附近。这种效应虽然微小但方向上是一致的，并且对于gpt-5-mini，当跨上下文长度合并时，硬负样本显著低于长度匹配的随机干扰项。我们发布了数据和评估代码，以进行可重复的上下文退化研究。
